steps.message: Assessed all four enriched selected education notices against fresh source text, recent published posts, older post guards, and recent refusal history. The student and book-loan registration notice supplies one concrete chore but no process details for a bounded experiment; the other three describe broad roles only. No candidate meets the threshold, so no post is proposed.
